Pearl by Pearl
Click 🎧 to listen.
Listen to a conversation between two students. The girl is discussing her opinion about how the author Sandra Cisneros wrote The House on Mango Street. Listen carefully. You will hear the conversation only once. After listening, you will answer four questions about the conversation and the evidence the girl gives to support her opinion. As you listen, you may take notes.
Listen to the Conversation
1QUESTION 1:
Why does the girl bring up the introduction that Cisneros wrote herself?
2QUESTION 2:
According to the girl, how does she know the short form was intentional?
3QUESTION 3:
What does the girl say the “My Name” chapter shows?
4QUESTION 4:
What does the girl mean when she says, “The form is the meaning”?
Answer all 4 questions to submit.
Choose the best answer for each question. You may change your answers before submitting.
SMART SUPPORT:
Go back to the conversation. Locate the line where the girl says what the author chose. Locate the line that names how she knows it was on purpose. Locate the line about the chapter called My Name. Locate the line that states what the book's form really does.
